    Aspose.Cells FOSS for .NET Documentation

    Overview

    Aspose.Cells FOSS for .NET is an open-source spreadsheet library for working with Excel .xlsx workbooks in .NET applications. It exposes an Aspose.Cells-style API and supports both workbook authoring and supported PDF export.

    Highlights

    • Workbook creation, load, edit, and save
    • Worksheet, cell, row, and column operations
    • Styles, number formats, and date handling
    • Formulas, data validation, and conditional formatting
    • Hyperlinks, defined names, tables, pictures, shapes, charts, and comments
    • Page setup and PDF export
    • Recovery-oriented workbook loading with diagnostics

    Quick Start

    using Aspose.Cells_FOSS;

var workbook = new Workbook();
var worksheet = workbook.Worksheets[0];

worksheet.Cells["A1"].PutValue("Name");
worksheet.Cells["B1"].PutValue("Age");
worksheet.Cells["A2"].PutValue("John");
worksheet.Cells["B2"].PutValue(25);

var style = worksheet.Cells["B2"].GetStyle();
style.Font.IsBold = true;
worksheet.Cells["B2"].SetStyle(style);

workbook.Save("output.xlsx");
